lines.japanese: 「おおー、羽田！　はよっ、今日ヒマ？」
lines.english: “Oh, Haneda! Morning! You free today?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 教室へ入るなり、藤野君から声をかけられた。
lines.english: Fujino called out to me the moment I entered the classroom.

lines.japanese: そんな僕らの様子に、他のクラスメイトが苦笑している。漏れきこえる冷やかしから推測するに、どうやら藤野君は、入ってくる級友を片っ端から捕まえていたようだ。
lines.english: Our other classmates watched us with wry smiles. Judging by the teasing I overheard, Fujino had apparently been accosting every classmate who came through the door.

lines.japanese: 「な、ヒマ？　今日の放課後ヒマじゃね？」
lines.english: “So? You free? You're free after school today, right?”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、予定はないけど、暇ってわけでも……」
lines.english: “Hmm. I don't have any plans, but I wouldn't say I'm free...”

lines.japanese: 「はーっ、だよなあ、受験ベンキョーだろ？　どいつもこいつも、これだから進学クラスはよー」
lines.english: “Ugh, figures. Studying for entrance exams, right? This is what I get in a college-track class. Every damn one of you.”
“Yeah...”

lines.japanese: まだ親しいひとにしか言ってないけれど、僕は卒業したあとしばらく治療に専念することを選んだ。だから実を言えば、今年の受験戦争からはすでにリタイヤしている。
lines.english: I had only told the people closest to me, but I had decided to devote myself to treatment for a while after graduation. The truth was, I had already dropped out of this year's college-entrance rat race.

lines.japanese: その代わりというわけではないけれど、放課後や休日の時間のあるときなどには、千歳君や成田君のあとを引きついで彼らのバイト先へ出向いたりしていた。
lines.english: It wasn't exactly to make up for that, but whenever I had time after school or on days off, I visited the places where Chitose and Narita used to work and carried on in their stead.

lines.japanese: 「くっそー、ひとりでも捕まんねーかな……ああーっと鴻野！　今日ヒマかあ！？」
lines.english: “Dammit. Can't I catch even one person...? Oh! Kono! You free today?!”

lines.japanese: 新たな級友が現れるなり、藤野君はそちらへ駆けだしていった。
lines.english: The moment another classmate appeared, Fujino ran off toward him.

lines.japanese: 「……いったい何の話でしょう？」
lines.english: “...What is all this about?”

lines.japanese: 先に登校していた針生さんに訊ねてみる。彼は読んでいた文庫本から目も上げずに言った。
lines.english: I asked Hariu, who had arrived before me. He answered without looking up from the paperback he was reading.

lines.japanese: 「さあなァ。俺、声かけられてねえし」
lines.english: “Hell if I know. He didn't ask me.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんですか……」
lines.english: “I see...”

lines.japanese: さぼり常習犯だった針生さんだけど、その出席率はここ最近になって上昇しつつあった。
lines.english: Hariu used to skip school habitually, but his attendance had been improving lately.

lines.japanese: しかし以前の僕がそうだったように、クラスのみんなはまだ年上の同級生に打ちとけていない節がある。
lines.english: Still, much as I once had, the rest of the class seemed unsure how to relax around a classmate older than they were.

lines.japanese: たしかに針生さんはちょっと斜に構えていて最初は近付きがたいけれど、本当はとても熱くて格好いいひとなんだ。
lines.english: Hariu did have a somewhat cynical air that made him hard to approach at first, but underneath it he was a passionate and very cool person.

lines.japanese: Ｒ－ウィングの名誉会員でもある僕（この前モンキの地下集会に顔を出したら、いつの間にかそういうことになっていた）は、自信を持って予言する──
lines.english: As an honorary member of R-Wing—a status I had somehow acquired the last time I attended one of their basement meetings at Monki—I could confidently predict one thing:

lines.japanese: ──何かのきっかけさえあれば、きっとみんなも“俺たちのハリュー”を好きになる。
lines.english: All it would take was the right opportunity, and everyone would come to love “our Haryuu.”

lines.japanese: 「おーい！　悪りいけど、ちょい注目ー」
lines.english: “Hey, everybody! Sorry, but listen up a sec!”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 振りむけば、教壇に立った藤野君が声を張りあげていた。
lines.english: I turned to find Fujino at the teacher's podium, raising his voice.

lines.japanese: 「今日の放課後、本屋の配置換えバイト募集中ー！　出来るやつ居たら、俺のとこまで！　男女問わず、４～５時間くらいで終わって５千円ニコニコ、ワリは悪くねーから！」
lines.english: “Anybody want a job helping rearrange a bookstore after school today? Come see me! Guys, girls, doesn’t matter. Four or five hours, five thousand yen cash. The pay ain’t bad!”

lines.japanese: いかにも切実な声だった。だけど唸り声や苦笑いがぽつぽつ浮かぶだけで、誰も手を挙げることはなかった。
lines.english: He sounded truly desperate. But the room only filled with scattered groans and wry laughter. No one raised a hand.

lines.japanese: クラスのみんなが受験生。なるほど、そういうことか。
lines.english: Everyone in the class was preparing for entrance exams. So that was it.

lines.japanese: 「藤野君、困ってるの？」
lines.english: “Are you in trouble, Fujino?”

lines.japanese: 僕は級友のもとへ向かった。背中に針生さんの呆れた笑いが刺さった気もする。
lines.english: I walked over to him. I thought I felt Hariu's exasperated laugh strike me between the shoulder blades.

lines.japanese: 「お、羽田キョーミ持った？　そう、俺いま、急遽ピンチヒッター探してんのよ」
lines.english: “Oh, you interested, Haneda? Yeah, I'm scrambling to find a pinch hitter.”

lines.japanese: 「ほら、俺ってバイト、本屋とコンビニで二個やってんじゃん？　それがうっかりしててさァ。今日のシフト、バッティングしちゃってぇ」
lines.english: “You know how I've got two jobs, one at the bookstore and one at the convenience store? Well, I screwed up. I got myself double-booked today.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、それは大変。どうするの」
lines.english: “What? That's terrible. What are you going to do?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、コンビニの方には、ぜってー休ませねーって言われちゃってンだけどォ」
lines.english: “The convenience store told me there is no freakin' way they're letting me off.”

lines.japanese: 「でも本屋の方は、代わりの人間さえ立てりゃ休んでもいいッつってんの。だからほんとマジ、代打立てねーとヤベーんだよ。あ～、誰か手伝ってくんねーかなぁ！」
lines.english: “But the bookstore said I can miss it if I find a replacement. So seriously, I'm dead unless I get somebody to pinch-hit. God, won't somebody help me out?”

lines.japanese: 「いいよ」
lines.english: “I will.”

lines.japanese: 次の瞬間、思わず立候補していた。
lines.english: The words were out of my mouth before I knew it.

lines.japanese: 「そういうことなら、おれが」
lines.english: “If that's the problem, I'll do it.”

lines.japanese: 「え！　マジで！　あ……でも羽田、なんか予定とか言ってなかったっけ」
lines.english: “What? Seriously? Oh... but didn't you say you had something to do, Haneda?”

lines.japanese: 「こっちは大丈夫。困ってるときはお互いさまだよ」
lines.english: “Nothing I can't set aside. We all have to help each other when we're in trouble.”

lines.japanese: 「うっわ、すっげ助かる！　も、ちょおアリガトだよ委員長！」
lines.english: “Holy crap, you just saved my life! Thank you so freakin' much, Class Rep!”

lines.japanese: 「そんな、大袈裟だって。おれも今月は残金ちょっと厳しかったから、思わぬ小遣い稼ぎが出来て嬉しいよ」
lines.english: “You're exaggerating. My funds were getting a little tight this month anyway, so I'm glad for the unexpected spending money.”

lines.japanese: よかった、藤野君が喜んでくれた。
lines.english: Good. Fujino was happy.

lines.japanese: 誰かの力になれるっていうのは、本当に気持ちのいいことだ。
lines.english: It truly felt good to be of use to someone.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そうだ。それとさ、一応あの、羽田の仲いいやつとか？　もう二、三人、テキトーに声かけてもらっていいかな」
lines.english: “Oh, right. One more thing. Could you maybe ask a couple of your friends too? Two or three, whoever.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　おれ一人じゃ足りないの？」
lines.english: “What? One person isn't enough?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、まあ、一人でもイイはイイんだけどォ。とりあえず、何人いても手が余るってことはないから、ま、多けりゃ多いだけ助かるカンジかも」
lines.english: “Well, one would technically be okay. But we can't really have too many hands, so I guess the more you bring, the more it helps.”

lines.japanese: 「助かるんだ……そう、分かった、いちおう探してみるよ」
lines.english: “It helps... Okay, I understand. I'll see who I can find.”

lines.japanese: いい顔をしたくてつい安請け合いしてしまった僕は偽善者だ。大して友人が多いわけでもないのに。
lines.english: I was a hypocrite. Wanting to look good, I had agreed far too readily, even though I didn't have that many friends.

lines.japanese: 仲のいいやつ、なんて言われて真っ先に浮かんだのは森里君の笑顔だけれど、残念ながら彼はいまだ入院中だ。
lines.english: The first face that came to mind when he said “friends” was Morisato's smiling face, but unfortunately, he was still in the hospital.

lines.japanese: あとネットで見たところによれば、本屋さんの仕事って意外と肉体労働らしいから、女の子には酷だろう。
lines.english: Besides, according to what I had read online, bookstore work involved a surprising amount of physical labor. It would be harsh on the girls.

lines.japanese: と、なると……。
lines.english: Which meant...

lines.japanese: 「フゥー……何か御用でしょうかァ、ファッキン委員長」
lines.english: “Haaaah... What do you want, fuckin' Class Rep?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はい。ちょっと聞きたいんですけど、針生さんは今日の放課後、なにか予定あります？」
lines.english: “Oh, yes. I wanted to ask whether you had any plans after school today, Hariu.”

lines.japanese: 「はッ！　おまえは相変わらず困ってるやつの手助けが好きだなァ」
lines.english: “Hah! You really can't resist helping anybody in trouble, can you?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いまの話聞こえてたんですね。どうです、一緒に？」
lines.english: “Oh, you heard all that. What do you say? Want to come with me?”

lines.japanese: 「ふン、俺には委員長や、あのいまだ名も知らぬ同級生に手を貸してやる義理はねえなァ」
lines.english: “Hmph. I owe neither the class representative nor that classmate whose name I still don't know a damn thing.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんはペットボトルのミネラルウォーターを掴んで、一口飲みくだした。
lines.english: Hariu picked up his bottle of mineral water and swallowed a mouthful.

lines.japanese: 「そうですよね……すみません、厚かましかったです」
lines.english: “Right... I'm sorry. That was presumptuous of me.”

lines.japanese: 「ふゥ……とは言え、あいにく俺も今月は厳しかったんだ。わずかばかり小銭でも稼がせてもらうか」
lines.english: “Haaah... That said, I’m a little short this month myself. Suppose I’ll go earn a little pocket money.”

lines.japanese: それは彼の優しい嘘だ。針生さんはかつて発明に凝っていた時期、膨大な特許料を稼いでいて、いまでも銀行口座に軽く一軒家が買える額の預金があるのだから。
lines.english: It was a kind lie. During a period when Hariu had been absorbed in inventing, he had earned a vast amount in patent royalties. Even now, his bank account held easily enough to buy a house.

lines.japanese: 「藤野君！　針生さんが手伝ってくれるって！」
lines.english: “Fujino! Hariu says he'll help!”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　ハリウッドのおっさん……あ、いやや、あの、針生サンが？　え、なんで……い、いいんですか」
lines.english: “Huh? The Hollywood geezer... Oh, uh, Mr. Hariu? Wh-why would... Is that really okay?”

lines.japanese: 「形ばかりの敬意なら結構だよ、ファッキン同級生。社会的観念に照合すりゃ、しょせん俺とおまえは対等だ。敬われる理由がねえ」
lines.english: “Spare me the empty respect, fuckin' classmate. By any social measure, you and I are equals. You've got no reason to treat me like a superior.”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　な、なんて？」
lines.english: “Huh? Wh-what did he say?”

lines.japanese: 「敬語はやめてほしいんだって。ああ見えて結構気さくなひとなんだ」
lines.english: “He wants you to stop talking so formally. He may not look it, but he's actually quite approachable.”

lines.japanese: 「ファック」
lines.english: “Fuck.”

lines.japanese: 「え、えええっ……？」
lines.english: “Wh-whaaat...?”

lines.japanese: 藤野君や周囲の男子はまだ躊躇していたけれど、針生さん自身がこんな感じなら、そう遠くないうちに彼らは良好な関係を築けるんじゃないかと思う。
lines.english: Fujino and the other boys nearby were still hesitant, but if Hariu himself kept acting like this, I thought they would build a good relationship before long.

lines.japanese: だって、僕を受けいれてくれたこのクラスは、とても優しくて楽しくて、ロックなひとたちばかりだから。
lines.english: After all, the class that had accepted me was full of kind, fun, rockin' people.

lines.japanese: 「えーっと、あと他に、力仕事向きのひとっていうと……」
lines.english: “Now, who else would be good at heavy lifting...?”

lines.japanese: あ、いた。
lines.english: Oh. I knew someone.

lines.japanese: よし、ちょっと声かけて来よう。
lines.english: All right. I would go ask him.

lines.japanese: 「おーい」
lines.english: “Heeey.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　あ、どうしたの山科さん」
lines.english: “Hm? Oh, what is it, Yamashina?”

lines.japanese: 「さっきから待ってるんだけど、私たちはいつ誘ってくれるのかな」
lines.english: “We've been waiting for a while. When were you planning to invite us?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「話のおおよそは聞こえてたから。渡来さん、羽田君が声かけに来るの待って、ずっとそわそわしてたんだよ」
lines.english: “We heard the gist of it. Watarai's been fidgeting this whole time, waiting for you to come ask her.”

lines.japanese: 「や、そわそわはしてないけど。ま、来るんじゃないのかなーぐらいの」
lines.english: “I wasn't fidgeting. I just figured he'd probably come over eventually.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、手伝ってくれるの？」
lines.english: “You'll help?”

lines.japanese: 「でも、結構な力仕事だっていうよ？　渡来さんはともかく、山科さん体大丈夫かな」
lines.english: “They say it’s pretty heavy work, though. Watarai aside, do you feel up to it, Yamashina?”

lines.japanese: 「渡来さんはともかく？」
lines.english: “Watarai aside?”

lines.japanese: 「ありがと、今日は問題ないよ。なんか最近調子いい日が続いてるんだ。学校が楽しいからセロトニンが足りてるのかも、ふふっ」
lines.english: “Thanks. I'll be fine today. I've actually had a string of good days lately. Maybe school has been so much fun that I'm finally getting enough serotonin. Hehe.”

lines.japanese: 「そう、よかった。じゃあ、これで羽田班勢ぞろいだね」
lines.english: “I'm glad. Then the whole Haneda team is assembled.”

lines.japanese: 「こふっ、こふっ……あ、いけない、お薬の時間だわ」
lines.english: “Cough, cough... Oh dear. Time for my medicine.”

lines.japanese: 「ン？　なんだ明日香、鬼の撹乱か」
lines.english: “Hm? What’s this, Asuka? Even ogres catch colds?”

lines.japanese: 「薄幸の美少女」
lines.english: “Try ‘tragic beauty, too frail for this world.’”

lines.japanese: 「ははははは」
lines.english: “Hahahahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「おかしくないっ！」
lines.english: “It's not funny!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、楽しくなってきた。嬉しいなあ、この四人でまた作業ができるなんて」
lines.english: “Now I'm getting excited. I'm so glad the four of us get to work together again.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、私まだ行くって言ってないけどー」
lines.english: “Uh, I never said I was going.”

lines.japanese: 「ほら羽田君、ちゃんと誘ってあげないから拗ねちゃったよ」
lines.english: “See, Haneda? You didn't invite her properly, so now she's sulking.”

lines.japanese: 「つーん」
lines.english: “Hmph.”

lines.japanese: 「チッ……腹立たしい表情だな。あいつ、アイアンクローで各パーツ真ン中に絞って、豚まんフェイスにしとくか」
lines.english: “Tch... What an irritating face. Maybe I'll give her an iron claw, squeeze all the features into the middle, and make her a pork-bun face.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君、針生さんは本気でやりかねないよ」
lines.english: “Haneda, Hariu might actually do it.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、あとで二人きりになったとき、改めて誘おうと思ったんだけどなあ。ほら、なんとなく渡来さんって、そういう方のが素直に応じてくれそうじゃないですか」
lines.english: “Hmm. I was planning to ask her properly later, when we were alone. I thought Watarai might be more willing to say yes that way, don’t you think?”

lines.japanese: 「つーん。私そんな面倒な女じゃありま──」
lines.english: “Hmph. I'm not that much trou—”
“—hngyii!”

lines.japanese: 「豚まん決定」
lines.english: “Pork bun it is.”

lines.japanese: 「いだっ、いだだだだっ！　寄る、寄る寄る、センターに寄る！　ギブギブギブ！」
lines.english: “Ow! Owowow! They're moving, they're moving! Everything's moving to the center! I give, I give!”

lines.japanese: 「や、やめてください針生さん！　このままでは渡来さんが肉まんになってしまいます！」
lines.english: “S-stop, Hariu! At this rate Watarai is going to turn into a meat bun!”

lines.japanese: 「豚まん」
lines.english: “Pork bun.”

lines.japanese: 「豚まんになってしまいます！」
lines.english: “She's going to turn into a pork bun!”

lines.japanese: 「どっちでもいい！」
lines.english: “Who cares which?!”

lines.japanese: 「はッ、止めるのか羽田。何故だ、おまえはこの女の外郭に惚れたのか？　そうでないと誓えるなら、こいつがいかなる醜貌になり下がろうとも受けいれられるはずだ」
lines.english: “Hah! Why stop me, Haneda? Have you fallen in love with this woman's outer shell? If you can swear you haven't, you should be able to accept her no matter how hideous she becomes.”

lines.japanese: 「はっ！　たしかに……」
lines.english: “Ah! That's true...”

lines.japanese: 「納得すんなーッ！」
lines.english: “Don't agree with him!”

lines.japanese: 「羽田、これは試練だ。おまえの脳にほとばしるドーパミンへ愛という名を与えたいなら、この試練を乗りこえてみせろ」
lines.english: “This is a trial, Haneda. If you want to give the dopamine flooding your brain the name of love, then overcome it.”

lines.japanese: 「ハハ！　出来るんだよなァ？　真実この世に愛なんてものが存在するというなら、出来るはずだよなァ、げらげらげら！」
lines.english: “Haha! You can do that, can't you? If love truly exists in this world, you ought to be able to! Gahahahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「あばっ、あがが、もがァー！」
lines.english: “Abah! Agagaga! Mngaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「うん、今日は楽しい放課後になりそうだね」
lines.english: “Yes. Today is going to be a fun afternoon.”

lines.japanese: 「やべえ、やべえよ……」
lines.english: “This is bad. Seriously bad...”

lines.japanese: 「あのおっさん、明日香さま豚まんヅラにして笑ってるよ、ありえねえ……俺なんかがタメ口利いたらぜってー殺される……こええー、こええよう」
lines.english: “That old bastard is laughing while he turns Lady Asuka's face into a pork bun. No freakin' way... If I talked to him like an equal, he'd definitely murder me... Scary. He's so scary...”
